text:
Leah (CS): quick alert 1:15 UTC 10 customers reporting 5xx during embeddings ingestion in eu-west. tickets piling in.
Tom (CS): are these new onboarders or existing tenants? need a comms template we can paste.
Ibrahim (Eng): looks specific to our rerank post-processing when certain long-doc tokenizations hit; one canary pod hit memory growth then evicted, causing fallback and occasional 503s.
Nina (SRE): filed INC-2026-2042, scaling the rollback now. monitoring shows spike at 21:12 UTC.
Leah (CS): customer note should be short, non-technical, include ETA and reassurance about document safety + offer a goodwill credit. Tom please draft.
Tom (CS): draft: ```Hi 021 0Were investigating intermittent ingestion errors impacting a small set of EU onboarding workflows. Our engineers are rolling back a recent deployment and monitoring recovery. No documents are lost; queued items will finish indexing once the service returns to normal. We expect recovery within ~30 minutes and will follow up with a detailed RCA within 24 hours. Sorry for the interruption.```
Ibrahim (Eng): tweak: replace "recent deployment" with "a canary release affecting rerank processing" and add "were disabling the canary while we push a fix". also: root cause = tokenization edge-case leading to memory retention in rerank worker.
Tom (CS): updated.
Leah (CS): excellent. Ill send this to the impacted list and DM our top-8 accounts with a personalized apology + one-time token credit. also scheduling a 10:00 CET office hours slot for anyone who needs help.
Nina (SRE): rollback completed at 21:28 UTC. error rate falling, 5xxs trending to baseline over last 4 minutes. NotifyBot: INC-2026-2042 status: rollback executed by Nina at 21:28 UTC; severity set to partial.
Ibrahim (Eng): canary remains disabled, patch to tokenization lib in review. will post patch ETA to the incident doc.
Leah (CS): please add a short troubleshooting blurb to paste for customers who reply: ```If youre still seeing errors: 1) Retry ingestion after 15 minutes; 2) Provide the request-id header from your logs; 3) If backlog persists after 60 minutes, reply and well prioritize manual reindex.```
Tom (CS): logging who to reach for manual reindex: cc @ingest-ops. also prepping a template to approve credits quickly for high-touch.
Leah (CS): follow-up checklist: 1) initial note sent (done); 2) top-8 outreach (Leah); 3) credit approvals (Tom); 4) RCA + timeline in 24h (Ibrahim); 5) office hours 10:00 CET (Leah).
Ibrahim (Eng): RCA summary for CS: cause = memory retention in rerank worker triggered by rare tokenization sequences; mitigation = rollback + tokenization patch + extended canary tests for long-doc payloads.
Leah (CS): perfect. Nina can you link the incident timeline and logs to the RCA doc so I can include it in the customer follow-up?
Nina (SRE): done 1:45 UTC 1I pushed timeline and logs to INC-2026-2042/doc.
Leah (CS): closing note 1: customers notified, rollback successful, monitoring stable. will reopen thread for any customer follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
